text:
alex: heads-up: a large mixed-dim embed batch (400 items, dims 512/768 varying) caused continuous-batching to hold resources for ~25s and pushed p99 up.
mei: did splitter reject any frames or just delay?
alex: a few 413s once framed payload exceeded max_bytes; most requests stayed open and blocked batching windows.
product-ux: customer-facing problem: they saw a generic 413 with no guidance. we should return actionable hints.
mei: propose lightweight flow: ingress quick-check calculates estimated_units from dims+compressed_size and if > SOFT_THRESHOLD return 429 with JSON: {"error":"oversize_request","estimated_units":X,"suggested_chunk":Y,"help_url":"https://docs/redwood/embeds/chunking"} so clients can retry. 429 keeps intent clear (rate/size).
alex: agree. also emit telemetry fields: embeds.oversize_flag, estimated_units, client_gzip, suggested_chunk.
telemetry-bot: schema proposal logged: embeds.oversize.v1 (fields: estimated_units, suggested_chunk, compressed_bytes_bucket).
product-ux: on Console show preflight estimator on paste with suggested chunk and "auto-chunk in SDK" toggle.
deploy-bot: deploy started: ingress-oversize-check v0.1 -> staging (sha: d4e5f6).
alex: will add unit tests for mixed-dim framing and a small canary rollout plan (metrics-only -> soft 5% -> default).
mei: also add header X-Embed-Suggest-Chunks on rejects for quick SDK parsing.
product-ux: i'll draft the modal copy and link to SDK examples.
alex: tagging @eng-oncall for canary watch. :eyes:
